data.explanation: This is the final bill (Schlussrechnung) for electricity from 1 January to 31 March 2026, issued because you moved out. It includes 212 kWh of extra consumption and a base fee. Pay €105.58 to the IBAN printed on the bill, quoting the invoice number, by the deadline shown. Check the consumption against your own meter reading from move-out. If something looks wrong, contact the Stadtwerke customer service.
